The Program

How it works

Rising Lite runs alongside your child's rec season. Once a week, Valor's staff coaches run a session focused on the ball: dribbling, first touch, and basic decision-making. There is no tryout and no team placement. Players work in small groups with kids their own age, which gives them a head start if they decide to try travel soccer later.

  • 01One session a week, led by Valor's staff coaches, for the full fall
  • 02Small groups, so players get real attention and touches on the ball
  • 03A Valor training jersey to keep and wear across the fall, winter, and spring sessions
  • 04No tryout, no team commitment, and no pressure to continue after the season
